output.question: How do I stage an upgrade and reduce the chance of configuration loss or image rejection?
output.reference_answer: Before upgrading from 5.0.x to 5.1.3 or 5.1.5 on Nimbus NF-300, keep each checkpoint file under 4,000 entries and verify the running configuration immediately after reboot. If the configuration contains more than 4,096 replay entries, split the upgrade into smaller chunks or export and re-import policy objects after first boot. On 5.0.8, stage 5.0.9 images with SCP or USB rather than HTTPS so the boot loader does not reject a valid image because of padding, and always verify the staged image hash before scheduling the reboot and confirm the image appears in software inventory with show software image.
